g.text: Each point: independent 500-round frozen query, rounds 491–500 mean. Zero = no support and no updates. One seed; no smoothing or error bars.

g.text: Shared uniform-action support per scenario. Positive budgets: base and extra mean-Q actor updates each = half the critic updates.
